landed.summary: Opened public pull requests that move public pages off the auth path and onto cached delivery: Omadesign's site gets a Cloudflare Workers target with Clerk removed from public pages (homepage payload cut from 788 KB to 64 KB), Mission Control OS gets a Workers target with Clerk limited to signed-in routes, and michaelchurley.com gets cached public pages, a smaller homepage hero and a public /book route. Still open at the end of the window.
